name: Microsoft Azure Portal

motion.capture_method: Official owner-published product recording excerpt (Getting started in the Azure Portal), static retrieval through the Invidious companion proxy; source interval 68.55-83.52s; transcoded with ffmpeg to local H.264 MP4; no browser or local GUI used.

states.name: Azure Quickstart Center on portal.azure.com with the 'Get started' tab underlined: 'Start a project' showing seven cards (Create a web app, Deploy a virtual machine, Deploy and run a container-based app, Set up a database, Get started with data analytics/machine learning and intelligence, Store back up or archive data, Build deploy and operate a serverless app) and 'Setup guides' showing Azure setup guide, Azure migration guide, Azure innovation guide and Send us your feedback; no mouse pointer is drawn anywhere in the frame
states.source_motion_path: frame of media/product-motion.mp4 at 8s (mean abs diff 0.2422/255); re-checked at full resolution, state-1 is pixel-identical (max channel difference 0/255) to the frame at 3.0s, while the frame at 8.0s already carries the mouse pointer at x17,y50 that state-1 does not have, so the 16x16 search could not resolve that 4x6-pixel difference

states.name: The same fully loaded Quickstart Center page with the mouse pointer now parked at x17,y50 immediately left of the 'Quickstart Center' heading; that pointer is the only difference from state-1 (mean absolute difference 0.05/255, 18 pixels differing by more than 25, every one of them inside x16-19 y48-54)
states.source_motion_path: frame of media/product-motion.mp4 at 6.5s (mean abs diff 0.2656/255); re-checked at full resolution, state-2 is pixel-identical (max channel difference 0/255) to the frame at 8.0s, and differs from 6.5s by 17 pixels because the pointer is still two pixels further right at 6.5s

states.name: The same Quickstart Center page with the same seven project cards, the same four setup-guide cards and the pointer still at x17,y50; it differs from state-2 only by low-amplitude encoder noise (mean absolute difference 0.81/255, 18 pixels above 25 scattered singly across the frame, no cluster)
states.source_motion_path: frame of media/product-motion.mp4 at 8.5s (mean abs diff 0.2148/255); confirmed pixel-identical (max channel difference 0/255) to the frame at 8.5s at full 640x360 resolution

interactions.name: primary activation
interactions.trigger: Activate the primary row, card, service, or control shown in the working surface.
interactions.response: The persistent console shell keeps context while the work area changes.
interactions.feedback: Selection styling and changed content identify the active target.
interactions.cancellation: Leave the control uncommitted or return to the previous view.
interactions.failure: A non-result leaves the prior context visible rather than inventing success.
interactions.recovery: Choose the visible valid target and activate it again.
interactions.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:03; corresponding retained frame where noted

interactions.name: focus and selection
interactions.trigger: Move focus or selection into the first actionable region.
interactions.response: The target becomes visually distinguished from adjacent items.
interactions.feedback: Highlight, outline, active-row color, or opened panel is visible.
interactions.cancellation: Move selection back to the prior region.
interactions.failure: An unavailable or unmatched target does not produce the populated result.
interactions.recovery: Return to the available item retained in the same shell.
interactions.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:04; corresponding retained frame where noted

interactions.name: navigation
interactions.trigger: Use the visible navigation, tab, breadcrumb, or collection entry.
interactions.response: The central work area changes without losing global context.
interactions.feedback: Heading, active destination, or view contents change.
interactions.cancellation: Use the persistent previous destination or breadcrumb.
interactions.failure: Wrong-destination content is recognizable before confirmation.
interactions.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:06; corresponding retained frame where noted

interactions.name: confirmation
interactions.trigger: Apply the visible primary action or accept the configured selection.
interactions.response: The product advances from configuration to a result-bearing state.
interactions.feedback: Changed status, populated content, or confirmation styling appears.
interactions.cancellation: Do not activate the final action or use the adjacent close/back route.
interactions.failure: Incomplete input keeps the result from appearing.
interactions.recovery: Correct the visible selection or field and apply again.
interactions.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:09; corresponding retained frame where noted

interactions.name: cancellation and backtracking
interactions.trigger: Use the visible back, close, cancel, previous destination, or retained navigation context.
interactions.response: The product returns without erasing the broader console context.
interactions.feedback: The preceding state or destination is restored.
interactions.cancellation: Stop before confirming a write action.
interactions.failure: Abandoning after a write would not restore server state automatically.
interactions.recovery: Reopen the retained item and continue from its current state.
interactions.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:02; corresponding retained frame where noted

interactions.name: system feedback
interactions.trigger: Wait after a navigation, selection, or action shown in the excerpt.
interactions.response: The interface settles from an intermediate to a populated state.
interactions.feedback: Loading, status, count, chart, table, or updated control is visible.
interactions.cancellation: Navigation can be abandoned before acting on the settled result.
interactions.failure: A pending or empty intermediate state is not treated as completion.
interactions.recovery: Keep context, wait, or reapply the selection until the populated state appears.
interactions.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:12; corresponding retained frame where noted

interactions.name: failure recognition
interactions.trigger: Observe the intermediate, unavailable, empty, or not-yet-populated state in the recorded transition.
interactions.response: The interface withholds completion evidence and retains actionable context.
interactions.feedback: Missing result, pending indicator, validation styling, or unchanged status distinguishes failure from success.
interactions.failure: Continuing from the unresolved state would not meet the stated first-success goal.
interactions.recovery: Return to the prior valid state and choose or apply the valid route shown next.
interactions.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:07; corresponding retained frame where noted

interactions.name: recovery
interactions.trigger: Re-select, correct, wait, or continue after the non-result state.
interactions.response: The retained shell transitions to the populated result visible at the end.
interactions.feedback: Result content and stable status replace the intermediate state.
interactions.cancellation: The operator can still leave through persistent navigation after recovery.
interactions.failure: If the result remains absent, completion is not claimed.
interactions.recovery: Repeat the visible valid route while preserving context.
interactions.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:12; corresponding retained frame where noted

journey.goal: reach a populated control-plane resource view and expose the next safe resource action
prerequisites: Access to the product surface or equivalent demo environment shown in the owner recording
Permission to view and operate the demonstrated resource or workspace
A populated example, sample, or connected data source where the product requires one

steps.user_action: Open the product surface shown by the owner-published walkthrough.
steps.system_response: The authenticated or product-ready shell and its initial context are visible.
steps.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:00; corresponding retained frame where noted

steps.user_action: Identify and enter the primary work region retained in the shell.
steps.system_response: A destination, row, card, or control becomes the active focus.
steps.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:03; corresponding retained frame where noted

steps.user_action: Navigate to or activate the target demonstrated in the excerpt.
steps.system_response: The work area changes and preserves global navigation/context.
steps.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:06; corresponding retained frame where noted

steps.user_action: Apply the shown selection, filter, configuration, or primary action.
steps.system_response: The interface enters an intermediate, loading, validation, or updating state.
steps.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:09; corresponding retained frame where noted

steps.user_action: Wait for feedback and inspect the resulting content or status.
steps.system_response: A populated, stable, and actionable result is visible.
steps.evidence: media/product-motion.mp4 at 00:00:12; corresponding retained frame where noted

failure_route: At the intermediate state, absence of populated content or unchanged status means first success has not occurred.
Do not continue to a consequential action from an unresolved or wrong-target state; use retained navigation to backtrack.
recovery_route: Return to the last retained valid context.
Choose the visible valid target or correct the shown selection/configuration.
Reapply or wait for system feedback, and accept completion only when the recorded populated result appears.
journey.completion_evidence: media/state-3.png, derived from media/product-motion.mp4 at approximately 00:00:12, retains the populated first-success result.

observations: Every card in 'Start a project' pairs its isometric blue icon with a text title and a sentence of body copy ('Create a web app / Build and deploy web apps that can scale', 'Deploy a virtual machine / Run your workloads in the cloud and reduce the redundancy and maintenance of physical hardware', 'Set up a database / Explore options for managing relational or nonrelational databases in the cloud'), so no card is identified by its icon alone.
The selected tab is marked by both its own text and a blue underline: 'Get started' is underlined beside the unstyled 'Take an online course', so the active tab is not signalled by colour alone.

Every card carries a written action link rather than a bare arrow or coloured chevron: 'Start >' on all seven project cards, 'Open >' on Azure setup guide / Azure migration guide / Azure innovation guide, and 'Feedback >' on 'Send us your feedback'.

Contrast measured from media/state-1.png: the 'Quickstart Center' heading glyphs (78,78,80) against the page background (255,255,255) give 8.3:1 over box x28-120 y47-62; the 'Create a web app' card title (116,116,116) against the white card (255,255,255) gives 4.67:1 over box x42-120 y116-126.

The shell stays put across all three retained frames at identical coordinates: the hamburger and 'Microsoft Azure' wordmark on the blue bar at y27-38, the search field spanning x188-455, the account address at the top right, and the 'Home >' breadcrumb at y24 - between state-1 and state-2 the only differing pixels in the whole 640x360 frame are the 18 belonging to the pointer.
unknowns: Keyboard focus order and keyboard operability were not exercised: no focus ring appears in any of the 60 sampled frames because nothing is focused or activated during the excerpt.
Screen-reader names, roles, live-region announcements, and error announcement timing were not inspected.
Zoom/reflow behaviour and high-contrast mode were not inspected, and only the two contrast pairs listed above were measured, both from the 640x360 retained frames.
The placeholder text inside the global search field is present but too small to transcribe reliably at 640x360, so its wording was not recorded.
A product-level reduced-motion preference was not demonstrated in the source excerpt.

motion_analysis.trigger: No control is activated anywhere in the excerpt. The only input visible is the mouse pointer, which is not drawn at all in any frame from 0.00s to 5.75s, first appears at 6.00s at x57,y25 in the 'Home >' breadcrumb row, and travels to x17,y50 beside the 'Quickstart Center' heading by 6.50s, where it stays for the remaining 8.4 seconds.
motion_analysis.start_state: Quickstart Center at 0.00s already fully loaded: 'Get started' tab underlined next to 'Take an online course', the 'Start a project' blurb ('Learn about popular Azure services and create your first Azure project...'), all seven project cards each with a 'Start >' link, and the 'Setup guides' section with Azure setup guide, Azure migration guide, Azure innovation guide ('Open >') and 'Send us your feedback'. No spinner, skeleton, or empty placeholder is present.
motion_analysis.end_state: The same page at 14.90s with identical headings, identical card titles and identical body copy; the only change from 0.00s is the pointer resting at x17,y50.
motion_analysis.continuity: The layout is spatially frozen. Comparing the frame at 3.00s with the frame at 14.90s, only 20 pixels differ by more than 30/255 and 17 of those are the pointer glyph itself; the remaining three are isolated single pixels at (78,124), (140,16) and (230,17). No card, heading, tab, or shell element is repositioned or redrawn.
motion_analysis.feedback: No feedback of any kind appears, because nothing is activated: no hover highlight on the card the pointer crosses, no focus ring, no spinner, and no status text changes in any of the 60 frames sampled at 4 fps.
motion_analysis.reduced_motion_equivalent: Not demonstrated: no motion-preference control appears in the frame, and the excerpt contains no animation for a reduced-motion mode to replace; the nonanimated equivalent retained here is the ordered three-frame set.
